trap.label: not so much … as
trap.wrong: It was not so much the house than the silence that hurt.
trap.right: It was not so much the house as the silence that hurt.
trap.why: Em português “não tanto X quanto Y” e “mais X do que Y” se misturam. Em inglês, not so much … as; the comparação com than é de more/less.

mcq.q: “Less out of anger ___ out of habit.”

fix.wrong: She was more afraid as angry.
fix.right: She was more afraid than angry.

fix.wrong: It was not so much anger but habit.
fix.right: It was not so much anger as habit.

fix.wrong: They talked rather than to fight.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com not so much…as: “It was the silence, more than the house.”
rewrite.answer: It was not so much the house as the silence.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com less…than: “She acted from habit more than anger.”
rewrite.answer: She acted less out of anger than out of habit.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com rather than: “They talked and did not fight.”
